args.request: put a gorge downstream of the start

goals.text: a gorge on the river below the start

ended: Added a gorge on the main river below the start, in the centre of the map, about two thirds of the way down: 16 tiles long and 5 wide, with walls 3 levels above the river bed. It is 42 tiles from the start. Note: the river's existing small falls (a 2-level drop) now sits inside the gorge. Every start rule still holds.
